# Diamonds Drill Clothing

> Expérience minière — Quebec-inspired mining streetwear from the drift.

Diamonds Drill Clothing (site in Quebec French: Diamonds Drill Clothing,
« Expérience minière ») is a mining streetwear brand from Quebec built around
underground trade culture. It is made for the people at the working face:
drillers (foreurs), muckers (muckeurs) and the whole underground gang — in the
brand's own words, « toute la gang du fond », the whole gang from down below.
The voice is working-crew pride, rock-solid, light Quebec French humour.
The flagship slogan is « Quand elle résiste, nous on insiste ! » —
"When it resists, we insist!" As the brand puts it: it's not a slogan,
it's a work shift.

## The interactive mine experience

The homepage is not a classic storefront. It renders a full-screen HTML canvas
mini-game — "Descendre dans la mine" (descend into the mine). The visitor
drills ore veins — four of them: Quartz (Les essentiels), Diamant (Collection
Foreur, the flagship), Or (Éditions limitées) and Équipe (Entreprise /
Équipes) — and each unlocked vein opens a collection, announced as « Filon
débloqué » ("Filon unlocked"). The drill rule is spelled out on site:
« 3 forages ou 10 secondes — le premier gagne » ("3 drills or 10 seconds —
first one wins"). The brand values displayed underground are Force,
Précision, Passion, Résultats. Experience copy on the site is in Quebec
French.

## The collection

Five designs, each cut in two ways: black T-shirt (T-shirt noir) or black
hoodie (Hoodie noir). Product format is always the same: a small logo on the
heart side in front, a medium visual on the back — toujours ("always").

- **Diamonds Drill — Flagship.** The manifesto piece. « Quand elle résiste,
  nous on insiste ! » / "When it resists, we insist!" For those who actually
  know the rock — for drillers, muckers, the whole underground crew. It is
  not a slogan, it's a work shift.
- **Muckeurs — Rose** (Muckers — Pink). For the women of the underground —
  the ones running the scoop on 12-hour shifts. Pink is not a concession;
  it's a flag.
- **Muckeurs — Jaune** (Muckers — Yellow). For the mucking crew: cleaning
  the face, loading, moving the mine forward one bucket at a time. No
  muckers, no mine.
- **Conventional Mining.** The conventional cycle spelled out: muck, drill,
  blast — repeat. For the jackleg and drift crews who live every step of
  the cycle, shift after shift.
- **Surface Drilling** (FR name on site: Forage de surface). Surface diamond
  drilling: the rig, the crew, the terrain. For teams that mount the rigs
  in the mosquitoes and still deliver — field people, not office people.

## Shop status

- Personalization: your name on the heart side, +8 CAD.
- Prices: coming soon (« bientôt disponible »).
- Payment: Stripe checkout will be activated once the client's Stripe account
  is open.
- Product format: heart-position small logo front, medium visual on the
  back — always; black tee/black hoodie.
